name: Volatility Regime Momentum
hypothesis: Trend continuation is conditional on the volatility regime: in calm regimes order flow is more persistent, so a simple moving-average cross should carry information, while in turbulent regimes the same signal is dominated by noise and should be suppressed.
falsifiable_prediction: The calm-regime subset must outperform the turbulent-regime subset by a clear margin. If the edge is equal or stronger in turbulence, the regime-conditioning premise is false.

parameters.name: vol_lookback
parameters.description: Bars used to measure the volatility regime.

parameters.description: Trade only when realised vol is below this quantile.
